sloka: स भूत्वा सुमहाकायो हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।धृष्टमास्फोटयामास लङ्कां शब्देन पूरयन् ।। ५.४२.३१।।।।
transliteration: sa bhūtvā sumahākāyo hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।dhṛṣṭamāsphoṭayāmāsa laṅkāṁ śabdena pūrayan ।। 5.42.31।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, son of Maruti, enlarged his body to a huge size and patted himself wildly making loud noise that echoed the entire Lanka.
